title: Two Sides of a Point
goal: Set two sides of a point against each other with por una parte … por otra and mientras que.

items: I can set two sides of a point against each other with por una parte … por otra.
I can contrast two people or things in one sentence with mientras que.
I can use the new words for weighing two sides.
